plainText:
Kyle Hebert is an American actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Hebert is an American voice actor who became an active voice actor in 1996. Hebert first worked on Pokémon voicing characters in before voicing roles in Pokémon Origins and Pokémon Generations before joining the in , voicing several roles, most notably Goh's Darmanitan.
